characters.role: CRO — the symbol, moral authority, leads with the mission not the method
CEO — strategic command, resources, the plan behind the plan
CTO — technical implementation, integrated systems, half the infrastructure is him
COO — execution speed, operations, logistics, gets there first
CMO — diplomacy, external relations, truth (the lasso does not lie)
CSO — context, state, deep background, shapeshifts to what the moment needs
